jobs.occupation: 4D ICE (Intracardiac Echocardiography) and Interventional Ultrasound EMEA - Clinical Application Spe (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global team as 4D ICE (Intracardiac Echocardiography) and Interventional Ultrasound EMEA - Clinical Application Specialist (f/m/d) to drive the adoption of one of the most innovative imaging technologies in Structural Heart and Electrophysiology.In this role, you will collaborate closely with internationally recognized physicians, Key Opinion Leaders, and leading global partners in the Structural Heart and Electrophysiology space. You will support a broad range of advanced procedures, including transcatheter valve interventions, left atrial appendage (LAA) closure, electrophysiology procedures, and emerging therapies. At the same time, you will help shape the future of interventional imaging by incorporating direct customer feedback and driving clinical innovation in one of the fastest-growing fields of cardiovascular medicine.Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.This position can be filled within Germany.Your tasks and responsibilities:Drive Clinical Adoption* You lead the successful clinical adoption of AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE and Interventional Ultrasound technologies across EMEA.* You support physicians and cath lab/EP teams by providing expert clinical and technical guidance during procedures and enabling the effective use of the AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE Catheter and interventional ultrasound technologies.Develop Education and Training* You create and deliver high-quality training programs and educational content for customers as well as internal commercial and clinical teams, while maintaining deep expertise in the clinical application of intracardiac echocardiography.* You support major international congresses, customer events, and educational initiatives across EMEA, including hands-on workshops, simulation training, and clinical demonstrations.Collaborate Across the Structural Heart Ecosystem* You work closely with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), build trusted relationships, and act as the voice of the customer by gathering clinical insights and supporting continuous product improvement.* You partner with commercial, marketing, product management, and R&D teams to share clinical feedback and contribute to ongoing innovation and product development.Support Commercial Success* You provide clinical expertise to identify customer needs and collaborate with commercial teams to drive successful adoption and account growth.* You contribute to go-to-market initiatives and customer engagement strategies.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at UltrasoundYour qualifications and experience:* You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Medical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, or a related discipline.* You have many years of hands-on clinical experience in echocardiography, interventional cardiology, structural heart interventions, and/or electrophysiology within the medical technology industry.* Do you already have many years of sound professional experience e.g. as clinical application specialist or Cath Lab Nurse and further qualifications in this field, but no degree? Then we also look forward to receiving your application.* You possess strong expertise in advanced cardiac imaging, including solid knowledge of TEE, 3D/4D echocardiography and preferably ICE.* You have a proven track record of delivering impactful product demonstrations, providing clinical education, and leading physician training sessions in complex clinical environments.* You bring expert knowledge of clinical procedures, workflow optimization, best practices, troubleshooting techniques, scientific literature, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.Your attributes and skills:* You thrive in an international matrix organization, can effectively manage multiple priorities, and communicate fluently in English; German language skills are a strong advantage.* You have a strong ability to understand customer needs, translate clinical insights into actionable recommendations, and effectively communicate them to commercial and cross-functional teams.* With excellent communication and interpersonal skills, you build trusted relationships with physicians, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and other stakeholders, and are able to educate, influence, and drive collaboration.* You are self-motivated, curious, and solution-oriented, with a passion for innovation, continuous learning, and improving patient care.* In addition, you are willing and able to travel extensively within your area of responsibility (approximately 80%).Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Career Site.As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here to get started.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

jobs.description: Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural ValidationHelp Accelerate Industrial DecarbonizationJoin exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology. Your ImpactThe structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.What You'll DoDesign & Improve Structural Systems- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.Lead Material & Component Testing- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.Develop & Validate Engineering Models- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.- Validate simulation results through physical testing.- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.Collaborate Across Engineering- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.Who You AreYou're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.Ideally, you'll bring:- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.What You'll Find at GlassPoint- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization. We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation. GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer Neuroscience (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.employer_name: Universitätsklinikum der Technischen Universität München AöR
jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer NeuroscienceFull- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für ChirurgieWe are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.Your responsibilities:The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.Depending on expertise, projects may include:- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscienceA particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.This may include:- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models- management of genetically modified mouse colonies- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfareYour profile:We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular BiologyYou should have:- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments- excellent scientific communication skills in English- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working styleParticularly desirable is extensive experience with:- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniquesWe offer you:- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. - Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant
